English: The Ministry of Education reminds parents that enrolment for Grade One is open at all public primary schools.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha wazazi kwamba uandikishaji wa Gredi ya Kwanza unaendelea katika shule zote za umma za msingi.

English: Teenage mothers are encouraged to return to school, and no school should deny them readmission.
Kiswahili: Wakina mama wa kijana wanahimizwa kurejea shuleni, na hakuna shule inayopaswa kuwanyima kukubaliwa tena.

English: Needy students can apply for county bursaries through their ward education offices.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi maskini wanaweza kuomba misaada ya masomo ya kaunti kupitia ofisi za elimu za kata zao.

English: HELB invites eligible university and college students to apply for loans through the online portal.
Kiswahili: HELB inawaalika wanafunzi wa vyuo vikuu na vyuo wanaostahili kuomba mikopo kupitia lango la mtandaoni.

English: Adult literacy classes are offered free of charge at community learning centres across the county.
Kiswahili: Madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima yanatolewa bure katika vituo vya kujifunzia vya jamii katika kaunti nzima.

English: Every child has the right to education; parents who keep children at home risk legal action.
Kiswahili: Kila mtoto ana haki ya kupata elimu; wazazi wanaowazuia watoto wao kuhudhuria shule wanaweza kuchukuliwa hatua za kisheria.

English: The sub-county education office will register children who missed enrolment during the school holidays.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya elimu ya wilaya ndogo itawaandikisha watoto walioachwa nyuma wakati wa uandikishaji.

English: The Teachers Service Commission urges communities to keep girls in school until they complete their secondary education.
Kiswahili: TSC inahimiza jamii kuweka wasichana shuleni hadi wamalisize elimu yao ya sekondari.

English: Parents are asked to collect admission letters for their children from the schools where they were placed.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanaombwa kuchukua barua za kujiunga za watoto wao kutoka shule walizowekwa.

English: KUCCPS reminds candidates who have not secured placement to revise their course choices during the open window.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawakumbusha watahiniwa ambao bado hawajapata nafasi kupitia tena uchaguzi wao wa kozi katika kipindi kilichofunguliwa.

English: The Ministry of Education urges youth to enrol in TVET colleges for practical skills that lead to employment.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahamasisha vijana kujiunga na vyuo vya TVET ili kupata ujuzi wa vitendo unaowezesha kuajiriwa.

English: Apprenticeship opportunities are available for youth interested in plumbing, welding, and electrical work at county workshops.
Kiswahili: Fursa za kujifunzia ufundi kwa kazi zinapatikana kwa vijana wanaopenda ufundi wa mabomba, kushomelea na umeme katika karakana za kaunti.

English: KUCCPS has opened applications for diploma and certificate courses in public technical and vocational institutions.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS imefungua maombi ya kozi za diploma na vyeti katika taasisi za umma za mafunzo ya kiufundi na kitaaluma.

English: Graduates of vocational training can access government tools and startup support through their local youth offices.
Kiswahili: Wahitimu wa mafunzo ya ufundi wanaweza kupata zana za serikali na msaada wa kuanzisha biashara kupitia ofisi za vijana za eneo lao.

English: Employers are encouraged to offer industrial attachment placements to TVET students in their workshops and firms.
Kiswahili: Waajiri wanahimizwa kutoa nafasi za kujifunzia kwa vitendo kwa wanafunzi wa TVET katika karakana na makampuni yao.

English: Technical training institutes will admit students who sat their national examinations regardless of their final grades.
Kiswahili: Taasisi za mafunzo ya kiufundi zitawakubali wanafunzi waliofanya mitihani yao ya kitaifa bila kujali alama walizopata.

English: Youth who complete artisan courses can register for trade tests to have their skills formally recognised.
Kiswahili: Vijana wanaomaliza kozi za ufundi wa vitendo wanaweza kusajiliwa kwa mitihani ya ufundi ili ujuzi wao utambuliwe rasmi.

English: The county government will sponsor needy youth to join vocational training centres within their sub-counties.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya kaunti itawadhamini vijana maskini kujiunga na vituo vya mafunzo ya ufundi vilivyomo katika wilaya zao ndogo.

English: Parents are advised to guide their children towards technical courses, which offer strong opportunities for self-employment.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanashauriwa kuwaongoza watoto wao kuelekea kozi za kiufundi, ambazo hutoa fursa nzuri za kujiajiri.

English: Workers who acquired their skills informally can now be assessed and certified through recognition of prior learning.
Kiswahili: Wafanyakazi waliojifunza ujuzi wao kwa njia isiyo rasmi sasa wanaweza kupimwa na kutunukiwa vyeti kupitia utambuzi wa ujuzi uliopatikana hapo awali.

English: Schools are encouraged to hold civic education sessions that teach learners about their rights and responsibilities as citizens.
Kiswahili: Shule zinahimizwa kufanya vikao vya elimu ya kiraia vinavyowafundisha wanafunzi kuhusu haki na wajibu wao kama raia.

English: The Ministry of Education will partner with civil society to deliver voter awareness programmes in secondary schools.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu itashirikiana na asasi za kiraia kutoa programu za uelewa wa kupiga kura katika shule za sekondari.

English: Learners who turn eighteen are urged to register as voters and participate in choosing their leaders peacefully.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wanaofikisha umri wa miaka kumi na nane wanahimizwa kujisajili kama wapiga kura na kushiriki kwa amani katika kuchagua viongozi wao.

English: Community barazas will be held in every ward to educate residents on the importance of public participation in county planning.
Kiswahili: Mikutano ya baraza itafanywa katika kila kata kuwaelimisha wakazi kuhusu umuhimu wa ushiriki wa umma katika mipango ya kaunti.

English: Teachers are reminded to remain neutral when guiding classroom discussions on elections and national governance.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanakumbushwa kutokuwa na upendeleo wanapoongoza mjadala darasani kuhusu uchaguzi na utawala wa kitaifa.

English: Civic education materials in local languages are available at sub-county education offices for community trainers.
Kiswahili: Vifaa vya elimu ya kiraia kwa lugha za kienyeji vinapatikana katika ofisi za elimu za wilaya ndogo kwa ajili ya waelimishaji wa jamii.

English: Parents are encouraged to discuss national values such as honesty, respect, and responsibility with their children at home.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanahimizwa kujadiliana na watoto wao nyumbani kuhusu maadili ya kitaifa kama uaminifu, heshima na uwajibikaji.

English: The county government urges residents to attend public forums before decisions on development projects are made.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya kaunti inawahamasisha wakazi kuhudhuria mikutano ya umma kabla ya maamuzi kuhusu miradi ya maendeleo kufanywa.

English: School drama and music festivals will include themes that promote peace, tolerance, and national unity among learners.
Kiswahili: Tamasha za maigizo na muziki shuleni zitajumuisha mada zinazohimiza amani, uvumilivu na mshikamano wa kitaifa miongoni mwa wanafunzi.

English: Young people are reminded that voting is a right and a duty, and every voice counts in building the nation.
Kiswahili: Vijana wanakumbushwa kwamba kupiga kura ni haki na wajibu, na kila sauti ni muhimu katika kujenga taifa.

English: The Ministry of Education has distributed new textbooks to all public schools and will verify their use termly.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu imesambaza vitabu vipya vya kiada katika shule zote za umma na itathibitisha matumizi yake kila muhula.

English: School feeding programmes will continue in all public primary schools, and no child should be sent away from school.
Kiswahili: Programu za chakula shuleni zitaendelea katika shule zote za msingi za umma, na hakuna mtoto anayepaswa kufukuzwa shuleni.

English: Donors and well-wishers are invited to support school libraries by donating storybooks in English and Kiswahili.
Kiswahili: Wafadhili na wemaaji wanaalikwa kusaidia maktaba za shule kwa kutoa vitabu vya hadithi kwa Kiingereza na Kiswahili.

English: Schools that received ICT devices must ensure they are used for learning and kept in secure rooms.
Kiswahili: Shule zilizopokea vifaa vya ICT lazima zihakikishe vinatumiwa kwa kujifunzia na kuhifadhiwa katika vyumba salama.

English: Parents whose children qualify for the school meals programme should confirm registration with the head teacher.
Kiswahili: Wazazi ambao watoto wao wanastahili programu ya chakula shuleni wanapaswa kuthibitisha usajili na mwalimu mkuu.

English: The county education office will inspect school libraries to confirm that books are accessible to all learners.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti itakagua maktaba za shule ili kuthibitisha kwamba vitabu vinafikika kwa wanafunzi wote.

English: Secondary schools are reminded to keep laboratories stocked with basic materials for practical science lessons.
Kiswahili: Shule za sekondari zinakumbushwa kuhakikisha maabara zina vifaa vya msingi kwa ajili ya masomo ya vitendo vya sayansi.

English: Digital learning devices distributed to learners remain government property and must be returned in good condition.
Kiswahili: Vifaa vya kujifunzia vya kidijitali vilivyogawiwa wanafunzi vinabaki kuwa mali ya serikali na vinapaswa kurudishwa katika hali nzuri.

English: Head teachers must display the list of bursary beneficiaries on the school noticeboard for transparency.
Kiswahili: Walimu wakuu lazima wabandike orodha ya wafaidi wa misaada ya masomo kwenye ubao wa matangazo wa shule kwa uwazi.

English: Community members are urged to protect school property and report any vandalism of classrooms, desks, or water tanks.
Kiswahili: Wanajamii wanahimizwa kulinda mali ya shule na kuripoti uharibifu wowote wa madarasa, madawati au mizinga ya maji.

English: All schools must enforce anti-bullying rules and report serious cases to the sub-county education office immediately.
Kiswahili: Shule zote lazima zitekeleze sheria dhidi ya unyanyasaji na kuripoti kesi kubwa kwa ofisi ya elimu ya wilaya ndogo mara moja.

English: Parents should report any form of abuse against a child to the nearest chief's office or police station.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanapaswa kuripoti unyanyasaji wa aina yoyote dhidi ya mtoto katika ofisi ya chifu aliye karibu au kituo cha polisi.

English: Learners with disabilities have the right to learn, and schools must provide reasonable support for their needs.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wenye ulemavu wana haki ya kujifunza, na shule lazima zitoe msaada unaofaa kwa mahitaji yao.

English: School administrations must ensure that toilets, classrooms, and playgrounds are safe and accessible to every learner.
Kiswahili: Utawala wa shule lazima uhakikishe kwamba vyoo, madarasa na viwanja vya michezo ni salama na vinafikika kwa kila mwanafunzi.

English: Teachers are urged to watch for signs of distress in learners and refer them for guidance and counselling.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanahimizwa kuwa makini na ishara za huzuni kwa wanafunzi na kuwaelekeza kwa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri.

English: The Ministry of Education directs all schools to hold regular safety drills for fire and other emergencies.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inaagiza shule zote kufanya mazoezi ya usalama mara kwa mara kwa ajili ya moto na dharura nyingine.

English: Girls must not be discriminated against in science, mathematics, or any subject offered in our schools.
Kiswahili: Wasichana hawapaswi kubaguliwa katika masomo ya sayansi, hesabu au somo lolote linalotolewa katika shule zetu.

English: Schools receiving learners with special needs will get additional resources and trained teachers to support inclusion.
Kiswahili: Shule zinazopokea wanafunzi wenye mahitaji maalum zitapata rasilimali za ziada na walimu waliofundishwa ili kuunga mkono ushirikishwaji.

English: Parents are reminded to accompany young children to school and teach them road safety rules.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanakumbushwa kuwasindikiza watoto wadogo hadi shuleni na kuwafundisha sheria za usalama barabarani.

English: Any person who defiles or abuses a school child will face the full force of the law.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote atakayemtendea mtoto wa shule ubakaji au unyanyasaji atakabiliwa na nguvu kamili ya sheria.

English: NTSA reminds all road users to observe speed limits and avoid driving while tired or under the influence of alcohol.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha watumiaji wote wa barabara kuzingatia miinuko ya mwendo na kuepuka kuendesha gari wakiwa imechoka au chini ya ushawishi wa pombe.

English: Motorists are advised to avoid flooded roads and bridges until the water levels go down completely.
Kiswahili: Madereva wanashauriwa kuepuka barabara na madaraja yaliyofurika hadi kiwango cha maji kipungue kabisa.

English: Pedestrians should always use footbridges and zebra crossings, and wear bright clothing when walking at night.
Kiswahili: Waenda kwa miguu wanapaswa kutumia madaraja ya kuvuka na miwaba kila wakati, na kuvaa mavazi yanayong'aa wanapotembea usiku.

English: The Kenya Meteorological Department warns residents in low-lying areas to move to higher ground before the heavy rains begin.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Hali ya Hewa ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa maeneo ya chini kuhama na kwenda sehemu za juu kabla mvua kubwa haijaanza.

English: Every household is encouraged to prepare an emergency kit with water, food, medicine and a torch before the rainy season.
Kiswahili: Kila kaya inahimizwa kuandaa kifurushi cha dharura chenye maji, chakula, dawa na tochi kabla ya msimu wa mvua.

English: Parents are urged to teach children what to do during an earthquake: drop down, take cover and hold on firmly.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanahimizwa kuwafundisha watoto la kufanya tetemeko linapotokea: jilaze chini, jifiche na kushikilia kwa nguvu.

English: Boda boda riders and their passengers must always wear helmets to reduce the risk of serious injury on our roads.
Kiswahili: Waendesha pikipiki za boda boda na abiria wao ni lazima wavae kofia ngumu kila wakati ili kupunguza hatari ya kujeruhiwa vibaya barabarani.

English: Schools are advised to hold regular fire drills so that pupils and teachers know how to evacuate safely and quickly.
Kiswahili: Shule zinashauriwa kufanya mazoezi ya kukimbia moto mara kwa mara ili wanafunzi na walimu wajue jinsi ya kujikwamua kwa usalama na haraka.

English: Do not overload electrical sockets and always switch off appliances before leaving home to prevent fire accidents.
Kiswahili: Usipakize soketi za umeme zaidi ya kiasi na daima zima vifaa vya umeme kabla ya kuondoka nyumbani ili kuzuia ajali za moto.

English: In case of a fire outbreak, call the fire brigade immediately and never go back inside a burning building.
Kiswahili: Iwapo moto utazuka, pigia simu kikosi cha kuzima moto mara moja na usirudi ndani ya jengo linalowaka.

English: The National Police Service urges the public to report any suspicious persons or activities to the nearest police station without delay.
Kiswahili: Jeshi la Polisi la Kitaifa linahimiza umma kuripoti watu au shughuli zozote zinazoshukiwa katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu bila kuchelewa.

English: Residents are encouraged to join community policing forums and work closely with their local chief and police officers.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanahimizwa kujiunga na vikao vya usalama wa jumuiya na kufanya kazi kwa karibu na chifu na maafisa wa polisi wa eneo lao.

English: Under the nyumba kumi initiative, every household should know its neighbours and report strangers loitering in the area.
Kiswahili: Katika mpango wa nyumba kumi, kila kaya inapaswa kuwajua majirani zake na kuripoti wageni wanaozurura eneo hilo.

English: Always lock your doors and windows, and do not leave valuables visible through windows when you are away from home.
Kiswahili: Daima funga milango na madirisha yako kwa kufuli, na usiache vifaa vya thamani vikionekana kupitia madirisha unapokuwa hayupo nyumbani.

English: The DCI advises business owners to install security lights and alarm systems to deter thieves from targeting their premises.
Kiswahili: DCI inawashauri wafanyabiashara kufunga taa za usalama na mifumo ya kengele ili kuzuia wezi kuwalenga majumba yao ya biashara.

English: If you witness a crime, stay calm, do not confront the suspect, and report to the police as soon as it is safe.
Kiswahili: Ukishuhudia uhalifu, jikaze, usimkabili mshukiwa, na uripoti kwa polisi haraka iwezekanavyo kwa usalama wako.

English: Community members are reminded that mob justice is a crime; always hand over suspects to the police for lawful action.
Kiswahili: Wanajamii wanakumbushwa kwamba sheria ya kujichukulia mkononi ni uhalifu; daima wakabidhi wahukiwa kwa polisi ili hatua za kisheria zichukuliwe.

English: Motorcycle owners are advised to install tracking devices and park in well-lit, guarded areas to prevent theft.
Kiswahili: Wamiliki wa pikipiki wanashauriwa kufunga vifaa vya kufuatilia na kuegesha sehemu zenye mwanga na walinzi ili kuzuia wizi.

English: Local chiefs urge residents to attend barazas where security matters affecting the community are discussed openly and peacefully.
Kiswahili: Machifu wa maeneo wanahimiza wakazi kuhudhuria mabaraza ambayo masuala ya usalama yanayogusa jumuiya hujadiliwa kwa uwazi na kwa amani.

English: Do not share your travel plans or valuables on social media, as criminals may use this information to target your home.
Kiswahili: Usitangaze mipango yako ya safari au mali zako kwenye mitandao ya kijamii, kwani wahalifu wanaweza kutumia taarifa hizo kuilenga nyumba yako.

English: The public is urged to remain vigilant and report unattended bags or parcels in public places to security officers immediately.
Kiswahili: Umma unahimizwa kuwa waangalifu na kuripoti mifuko au vifurushi vilivyowekwa wazi mahali pa umma kwa maafisa wa usalama mara moja.

English: In the event of a security alert, follow instructions from uniformed officers and move calmly to the designated safe areas.
Kiswahili: Iwapo kutakuwa na tahadhari ya usalama, fuata maagizo ya maafisa wenye sare na uende kwa utulivu hadi maeneo salama yaliyoteuliwa.

English: Security agencies remind Kenyans that terrorism is defeated through cooperation between citizens and the government at all levels.
Kiswahili: Mashirika ya usalama yanawakumbusha Wakenya kwamba ugaidi hushindwa kupitia ushirikiano kati ya wananchi na serikali katika ngazi zote.

English: Do not take photographs of government installations or security operations, as this may endanger national security.
Kiswahili: Usipige picha vituo vya serikali au shughuli za usalama, kwani hili linaweza kuhatarisha usalama wa taifa.

English: Every Kenyan has a role in keeping the country safe; if you see something unusual, say something to the authorities.
Kiswahili: Kila Mkenya ana jukumu la kulinda usalama wa nchi; ukiona jambo lisilo la kawaida, lifafanue kwa mamlaka husika.

English: Schools and places of worship are encouraged to review their emergency plans and train members on safe evacuation procedures.
Kiswahili: Shule na mahali pa ibada vinahimizwa kupitia tena mipango yao ya dharura na kuwafundisha wanachama taratibu salama za kujikwamua.

English: During national emergencies, rely only on information from official government channels and avoid spreading unverified rumours.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa dharura za kitaifa, tumia tu taarifa kutoka vyanzo rasmi vya serikali na epuka kueneza uvumi usiothibitishwa.

English: Cooperate fully with security checks at public buildings, bus stations and shopping centres; these measures protect everyone.
Kiswahili: Shirikiana kikamilifu na ukaguzi wa usalama katika majengo ya umma, vituo vya mabasi na maduka makubwa; hatua hizi hulinda kila mtu.

English: Landlords and hotel operators are reminded to keep proper records of tenants and guests as required by security regulations.
Kiswahili: Wamiliki wa nyumba za kupanga na wahudumu wa mahoteli wanakumbushwa kuweka kumbukumbu sahihi za wapangaji na wageni kama inavyohitajika na kanuni za usalama.

English: Community leaders are urged to promote peace and report early signs of radicalisation or violent extremism to the authorities.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa jamii wanahimizwa kukuza amani na kuripoti ishara za mapema za itikadi kali na ugaidi kwa mamlaka husika.

English: Gender-based violence is a crime in Kenya; survivors are encouraged to report to the nearest police station or health facility.
Kiswahili: Ukatili wa kijinsia ni uhalifu nchini Kenya; washirika wanaopitia ukatili huu wanahimizwa kuripoti katika kituo cha polisi au kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.

English: If you or someone you know is experiencing abuse, call the national GBV helpline for free, confidential support at any time.
Kiswahili: Iwapo wewe au mtu unayemjua anapitia unyanyasaji, pigia simu laini ya kitaifa ya GBV kupata msaada wa bure na wa siri wakati wowote.

English: Survivors of violence deserve respect and care; seek medical attention within the recommended time and preserve any evidence safely.
Kiswahili: Waliopitia ukatili wanastahili heshima na utunzaji; tafuta huduma ya afya ndani ya muda unaopendekezwa na uhifadhi ushahidi wowote kwa usalama.

English: No one has the right to hurt you; support services will listen without judgement and help you make safe choices.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtu aliye na haki ya kukuumiza; huduma za msaada zitakusikiliza bila kukuhukumu na kukusaidia kufanya maamuzi salama.

English: Community members are urged to speak out against harmful practices and protect women, girls and boys from all forms of abuse.
Kiswahili: Wanajamii wanahimizwa kuongea dhidi ya desturi zinazodhuru na kuwalinda wanawake, wasichana na wavulana dhidi ya aina zote za unyanyasaji.

English: Chiefs and community elders are reminded that resolving defilement or assault cases at home is against the law; report them immediately.
Kiswahili: Machifu na wazee wa jamii wanakumbushwa kwamba kutatua kesi za ubakaji au mashambulizi nyumbani ni kinyume cha sheria; ziripoti mara moja.

English: NGOs supporting survivors offer counselling, legal guidance and safe shelter; reaching out for help is a sign of strength, not weakness.
Kiswahili: Mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali yanayowasaidia washirika hutoa ushauri, mwongozo wa kisheria na makazi salama; kutafuta msaada ni ishara ya nguvu, si udhaifu.

English: Men and boys are called upon to be allies in ending gender-based violence by challenging harmful attitudes in their communities.
Kiswahili: Wanaume na wavulana wanaalikwa kuwa washirika katika kukomesha ukatili wa kijinsia kwa kupinga mitazamo michafu katika jamii zao.

English: If you suspect a child is being abused, report to the children's officer or the nearest police station; your action can save a life.
Kiswahili: Ukishuki mtoto ananyanyaswa, ripoti kwa afisa wa watoto au kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu; hatua yako inaweza kuokoa maisha.

English: Everyone deserves to live free from fear; together we can build homes and communities where violence is never tolerated.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu anastahili kuishi bila hofu; kwa pamoja tunaweza kujenga nyumba na jamii ambako ukatili huvumiliwi kamwe.

English: The Communications Authority of Kenya warns the public never to share M-Pesa PINs or one-time codes with anyone, including callers claiming to be agents.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inaonya umma kutowahi kugawa PIN za M-Pesa au misimbo ya kuthibitisha na mtu yeyote, hata wanaojiita mawakala.

English: Safaricom and bank staff will never call to ask for your PIN or password; hang up and report such callers to the authorities.
Kiswahili: Wafanyakazi wa Safaricom na benki hawatawahi kupiga simu kuuliza PIN au nenosiri lako; kata simu na uwaripoti wapigaji kama hao kwa mamlaka.

English: Before sending money, confirm the recipient's name carefully and beware of fake reversal messages asking you to refund funds.
Kiswahili: Kabla ya kutuma pesa, hakikisha jina la mpokeaji kwa makini na ujihadhari na ujumbe bandia wa kurudisha pesa unaokuuliza kurejesha fedha.

English: Use strong passwords with a mix of letters, numbers and symbols, and never use the same password on different accounts.
Kiswahili: Tumia manenosiri imara yenye mchanganyiko wa herufi, nambari na alama, na usitumie nenosiri moja kwenye akaunti tofauti.

English: Parents are urged to monitor their children's online activities and teach them never to share personal details or photos with strangers.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanahimizwa kufuatilia shughuli za watoto wao mtandaoni na kuwafundisha kutogawa taarifa binafsi au picha kwa wageni.

English: Do not click on links promising free loans, prizes or job offers; genuine organisations never ask for fees through random messages.
Kiswahili: Usibofye viungo vinavyoahidi mikopo ya bure, zawadi au kazi; mashirika halisi hayawahi kuomba ada kupitia ujumbe wa nasibu.

English: If your phone is lost or stolen, report immediately to your mobile service provider and the police to block your lines and accounts.
Kiswahili: Iwapo simu yako imepotea au imeibiwa, ripoti mara moja kwa mtoa huduma wa simu na polisi ili kuzuia laini na akaunti zako.

English: Enable two-step verification on your email and social media accounts to keep hackers away from your personal information.
Kiswahili: Wezesha uthibitishaji wa hatua mbili kwenye barua pepe na akaunti zako za mitandao ya kijamii ili kuwazuia wadukuzi kufikia taarifa zako binafsi.

English: Online fraudsters often pretend to be friends in distress; always call the person directly to confirm before sending any money.
Kiswahili: Watangamizi wa mtandaoni mara nyingi hujifanya marafiki walio katika shida; daima pigia mtu huyo simu moja kwa moja kuthibitisha kabla ya kutuma pesa yoyote.

English: The DCI reminds Kenyans to report cybercrime, including online harassment and fraud, at any police station or through official reporting channels.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha Wakenya kuripoti uhalifu wa mtandaoni, ikijumuisha unyanyasaji na ulaghai wa mtandaoni, katika kituo chochote cha polisi au kupitia njia rasmi za kuripoti.

English: The EACC encourages citizens to report any public officer who asks for a bribe before providing a government service.
Kiswahili: EACC inahimiza raia kuripoti afisa yeyote wa umma anayeomba rushwa kabla ya kutoa huduma ya serikali.

English: No government service requires a bribe; refuse to pay, note the officer's name, and report to the EACC.
Kiswahili: Hakuna huduma ya serikali inayohitaji rushwa; kataa kulipa, andika jina la afisa, na uripoti kwa EACC.

English: Whistleblowers are protected by law; you can report corruption confidentially without fear of victimisation.
Kiswahili: Watoaji taarifa za ufisadi hulindwa na sheria; unaweza kuripoti ufisadi kwa siri bila hofu ya kunyanyaswa.

English: Public officers are reminded that declaring their wealth as required by law is not optional but a legal duty.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wa umma wanakumbushwa kwamba kutangaza mali zao kama inavyohitajika na sheria si lazima bali ni wajibu wa kisheria.

English: The EACC urges institutions to strengthen internal audit systems to prevent misuse of public funds.
Kiswahili: EACC inahimiza taasisi kuimarisha mifumo ya ukaguzi wa ndani ili kuzuia matumizi mabaya ya fedha za umma.

English: Citizens are urged to demand official receipts for every payment made at government offices.
Kiswahili: Raia wanahimizwa kudai risiti rasmi kwa kila malipo yanayofanywa katika ofisi za serikali.

English: Integrity begins with each of us; do not offer a bribe even when you are in a hurry to be served.
Kiswahili: Uadilifu huanza na kila mmoja wetu; usitoe rushwa hata ukiwa na haraka ya kuhudumiwa.

English: The county government will publish all tender awards publicly to promote transparency in procurement.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya kaunti itachapisha wazi tuzo zote za zabuni ili kukuza uwazi katika ununuzi.

English: Students and young people are encouraged to join integrity clubs in schools to promote honesty from an early age.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi na vijana wanahimizwa kujiunga na vilabu vya uadilifu shuleni ili kukuza uaminifu tangu utotoni.

English: Anyone who falsifies documents to obtain public funds will be prosecuted and required to repay every shilling.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote atakayegushi nyaraka ili kupata fedha za umma atafunguliwa mashtaka na kulazimishwa kulipa kila shilingi.

English: Members of the public are invited to submit their views on the proposed county budget at the ward offices.
Kiswahili: Wananchi wanaalikwa kuwasilisha maoni yao kuhusu bajeti iliyopendekezwa ya kaunti katika ofisi za wadi.

English: The county government will hold public hearings in every sub-county before finalising the development plan.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya kaunti itafanya vikao vya kusikiliza umma katika kila wilaya ndogo kabla ya kukamilisha mpango wa maendeleo.

English: Your voice matters; attend the next public participation forum and tell your leaders what your community needs.
Kiswahili: Sauti yako ni muhimu; hudhuria kikao kijacho cha ushiriki wa umma na uwaambie viongozi wako mahitaji ya jumuiya yako.

English: Residents can now submit memoranda on proposed bills through the county assembly website or in person.
Kiswahili: Wakazi sasa wanaweza kuwasilisha maombi yao kuhusu mswada uliopendekezwa kupitia tovuti ya bunge la kaunti au kwa kufika wenyewe.

English: Ward administrators will visit each village to collect views on priority projects for the coming year.
Kiswahili: Wasimamizi wa wadi watatembelea kila kijiji kukusanya maoni kuhusu miradi ya kipaumbele kwa mwaka ujao.

English: All public participation meetings are free and open to every resident, including persons with disabilities.
Kiswahili: Mikutano yote ya ushiriki wa umma ni ya bure na wazi kwa kila mkazi, ikiwemo watu wenye ulemavu.

English: Young people are encouraged to attend county budget forums to understand how public money is planned and spent.
Kiswahili: Vijana wanahimizwa kuhudhuria vikao vya bajeti ya kaunti ili kuelewa jinsi fedha za umma zinavyopangwa na kutumika.

English: The county assembly invites persons with disabilities to accessible forums; sign language interpreters will be provided.
Kiswahili: Bunge la kaunti linawaalika watu wenye ulemavu kwenye vikao vinavyowafaa; wakalimani wa lugha ya ishara watatolewa.

English: Community proposals submitted during public participation must be acknowledged and responded to within the set timelines.
Kiswahili: Mapendekezo ya jamii yanayowasilishwa wakati wa ushiriki wa umma lazima yatambuliwe na kujibiwa ndani ya muda uliowekwa.

English: Residents are reminded that public participation is a constitutional right, not a favour from leaders.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanakumbushwa kwamba ushiriki wa umma ni haki ya katiba, si neema kutoka kwa viongozi.

English: The IEBC urges all eligible Kenyans to confirm their voter registration details before the register is finalised.
Kiswahili: IEBC inahimiza Wakenya wote wanaostahili kuthibitisha taarifa zao za usajili wa kupiga kura kabla daftari halijakamilishwa.

English: Voter registration is free and open at all IEBC constituency offices; carry your national ID card.
Kiswahili: Usajili wa kupiga kura ni wa bure na unapatikana katika ofisi zote za IEBC za majimbo; beba kitambulisho chako cha kitaifa.

English: Every vote counts; plan your voting day early and encourage your family and neighbours to vote peacefully.
Kiswahili: Kila kura ni muhimu; panga siku yako ya kupiga kura mapema na uhimize familia na majirani zako kupiga kura kwa amani.

English: Kenyans are urged to reject violence and hate speech before, during and after the elections.
Kiswahili: Wakenya wanahimizwa kukataa vurugu na lugha za chuki kabla, wakati na baada ya uchaguzi.

English: First-time voters are reminded that the ballot is secret; no one should force you to reveal your choice.
Kiswahili: Wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza wanakumbushwa kwamba kura ni siri; hakuna mtu anayepaswa kukulazimisha kufichua chaguo lako.

English: Check your registration details through the official IEBC verification channels and correct any errors early.
Kiswahili: Kagua taarifa zako za usajili kupitia njia rasmi za uthibitishaji za IEBC na urekebishe makosa yoyote mapema.

English: Polling stations open in the morning; carry your identification document and follow the guidance of election officials.
Kiswahili: Vituo vya kupiga kura hufunguliwa asubuhi; beba hati yako ya kitambulisho na ufuate mwongozo wa maafisa wa uchaguzi.

English: Selling or buying votes is a crime punishable by law; report anyone attempting to buy your vote.
Kiswahili: Kuuza au kununua kura ni uhalifu unaoadhibiwa na sheria; ripoti mtu yeyote anayejaribu kununua kura yako.

English: The IEBC will provide assisted voting for persons with disabilities and priority queues for the elderly and expectant mothers.
Kiswahili: IEBC itatoa msaada wa kupiga kura kwa watu wenye ulemavu na foleni za kipaumbele kwa wazee na wakina mama wajawazito.

English: Peace begins with each of us; accept election results peacefully and use legal channels for any disputes.
Kiswahili: Amani huanza na kila mmoja wetu; kubali matokeo ya uchaguzi kwa amani na tumia njia za kisheria kwa migogoro yoyote.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds citizens that ID, passport and birth certificate services are available at all Huduma Centres.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha raia kwamba huduma za kitambulisho, pasipoti na vyeti vya kuzaliwa zinapatikana katika vituo vyote vya Huduma.

English: Save time by booking government services online through the eCitizen portal before visiting any office.
Kiswahili: Okoa muda kwa kupanga huduma za serikali mtandaoni kupitia lango la eCitizen kabla ya kutembelea ofisi yoyote.

English: Every government office must display its service charter showing waiting times and requirements for each service.
Kiswahili: Kila ofisi ya serikali lazima ionyeshe mkataba wake wa huduma unaonyesha muda wa kusubiri na mahitaji ya kila huduma.

English: If a public officer delays or denies you service unfairly, report to the office supervisor or the complaints desk.
Kiswahili: Iwapo afisa wa umma akikuchelewesha au kukunyima huduma bila sababu, ripoti kwa msimamizi wa ofisi au dawati la malalamiko.

English: The Ministry of Interior reminds applicants that birth and death certificates can now be applied for online.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Mambo ya Ndani inawakumbusha waombaji kwamba vyeti vya kuzaliwa na vya kifo sasa vinaweza kuombwa mtandaoni.

English: Applicants for passports should book appointments online and carry all required documents to avoid repeat visits.
Kiswahili: Waombaji wa pasipoti wanapaswa kupanga miadi mtandaoni na kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kurudiwa.

English: Government offices remain committed to serving all Kenyans equally regardless of their tribe, religion or background.
Kiswahili: Ofisi za serikali zinaahidi kuhudumia Wakenya wote kwa usawa bila kujali kabila, dini au asili yao.

English: Older persons and persons with disabilities are given priority service at all public offices.
Kiswahili: Wazee na watu wenye ulemavu wanapewa huduma ya kipaumbele katika ofisi zote za umma.

English: Members of the public are reminded to carry original identification documents when collecting official certificates.
Kiswahili: Wananchi wanakumbushwa kubeba nyaraka halisi za kitambulisho wanapokusanya vyeti rasmi.

English: Feedback boxes and digital surveys are available at Huduma Centres to help improve service delivery.
Kiswahili: Visanduku vya maoni na utafiti wa kidijitali vinapatikana katika vituo vya Huduma ili kusaidia kuboresha utoaji wa huduma.

English: County governments now issue business permits, health certificates and land rates services at sub-county offices.
Kiswahili: Serikali za kaunti sasa hutoa vibali vya biashara, vyeti vya afya na huduma za kodi za ardhi katika ofisi za wilaya ndogo.

English: Residents are urged to pay their business permits early to avoid penalties and keep county services running.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanahimizwa kulipa vibali vyao vya biashara mapema ili kuepuka faini na kuwezesha huduma za kaunti kuendelea.

English: Devolution brings services closer to you; visit your ward administrator's office for help with county matters.
Kiswahili: Ugatuzi unakuletea huduma karibu; tembelea ofisi ya msimamizi wa wadi yako kwa msaada kuhusu masuala ya kaunti.

English: County health facilities are open to all residents; register your household at the nearest dispensary or health centre.
Kiswahili: Vituo vya afya vya kaunti viko wazi kwa wakazi wote; sajili kaya yako katika zahanati au kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.

English: The county government will repair rural roads in phases; report impassable sections to your ward administrator.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya kaunti itakarabati barabara za vijijini kwa awamu; ripoti sehemu zisizopitika kwa msimamizi wa wadi yako.

English: Local communities are encouraged to form water user committees to manage boreholes and shared water points.
Kiswahili: Jamii za mitaa zinahimizwa kuunda kamati za watumiaji wa maji ili kusimamia visima na sehemu za pamoja za kuchota maji.

English: County bursaries target needy students in local schools; application forms are available at ward offices.
Kiswahili: Misaada ya masomo ya kaunti inalenga wanafunzi maskini katika shule za mitaa; fomu za maombi zinapatikana katika ofisi za wadi.

English: Market traders must display valid county licences and keep their stalls clean as required by public health rules.
Kiswahili: Wafanyabiashara wa masoko lazima waonyeshe leseni halali za kaunti na kuziweka duka zao safi kama inavyohitajika na kanuni za afya ya umma.

English: The county assembly holds public sessions; residents are welcome to attend and follow how their representatives work.
Kiswahili: Bunge la kaunti hufanya vikao vya umma; wakazi wanakaribishwa kuhudhuria na kufuatilia jinsi wawakilishi wao wanavyofanya kazi.

English: If a county service fails you, use the complaints desk at the governor's office or the county call centre to seek help.
Kiswahili: Iwapo huduma ya kaunti ikukwaze, tumia dawati la malalamiko katika ofisi ya gavana au kituo cha simu cha kaunti kutafuta msaada.
